name: Question 6
problem: A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin $O$ with acceleration, measured in $\text{m}/{\text{s}}^{2},$ given by the function $a(t)=12-3{t}^{2},$ where $t>0$ is the time  in seconds. If the particle has velocity $v=15\,\text{m}/\text{s}$ when $t=1\,\text{s},$ calculate the maximum velocity ${v}_{\text{max}}$ of the particle and determine the time when the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

Question 6
?

A particle moves along a straight line relative to a fixed origin O with acceleration, measured in m/s2, given by the function a(t)=12−3t2, where t>0 is the time in seconds. If the particle has velocity v=15m/s when t=1s, calculate the maximum velocity vmax of the particle and determine the time when the particle reaches its maximum velocity.

a
vmax=16m/s,t=2s
b
vmax=28m/s,t=2s
c
vmax=13m/s,t=3s
d
vmax=15m/s,t=1s
e
vmax=20m/s,t=2s
Submit
